english: When WASAC's record is wrong, for example after a meter is replaced, set what the meter shows now. The next reading is compared with it. Every correction is in Activity.
kinyarwanda: Iyo ibyanditswe na WASAC atari byo, urugero mubazi yasimbujwe, andika ibyo mubazi yerekana ubu. Igipimo gikurikiraho kizagereranywa na cyo. Ikosora ryose riba mu Bikorwa.

english: Choose a household, then type the reading (0 to 99999.999 m³) and a reason.
kinyarwanda: Hitamo urugo, hanyuma wandike igipimo (kuva kuri 0 kugeza kuri 99999.999 m³) n'impamvu.

english: A reading from this household is waiting in the review queue. Decide on it first.
kinyarwanda: Hari igipimo cy'uru rugo gitegereje mu bigomba kugenzurwa. Banza ugifateho icyemezo.

english: {meter} now reads {reading}. The next reading will be compared with it.
kinyarwanda: {meter} ubu yerekana {reading}. Igipimo gikurikiraho kizagereranywa na cyo.
